note: strategy/ mixes three different things: live runtime configuration (current/*.json), a human decision record (decision_log.md and the methodology set), and a 2026-07 archive of prompts written for an AI assistant. Only the first is executed.

entries.purpose: The typed Release 1 Business Strategy Configuration: brand_editorial, the two editorial roles with their surface rules and decision policy, channel rules, the acceptance rubric paths, and prompt_rule_references.
entries.consumer: PARTIAL. src/strategy/business_config.py:26,272 loads it on every canonical run (Monday, Wednesday, Research). Of the fifteen model calls on the Monday path, its content reaches three: decision_lens_lite (src/editorial/decision_lens_lite.py:148-163), never_blank_voice (never_blank_voice.py:135-146) and platform_composer channel + role rules (platform_composer.py:434-439,492-495). For Wednesday its role rules reach generation not at all; only the acceptance rubric path at :442 is honoured, and role rules reach LinkedIn only when a revision forces recomposition. Its prompt_rule_references block (:306-342) is validated for id/path/version and never opened.
entries.canonical: canonical machine configuration — and per the owner's 2026-09-15 ruling, JSON may only be a DERIVED representation of Markdown, which it is not today
entries.action_required: HIGH. Do not edit here. It is the subject of #240/#244 (Markdown-authoritative strategy with a compiler). This audit records what of it reaches a prompt today. F-03.
